FeatureAccess: Give access to a whole room or individual files through external links with flexible settings.
FeatureMembers: Add members to a room and assign roles that control what each person can do with the files.
FeatureRoomSecurity: Restrict downloading and copying, set link expiration, and use virtual data rooms for sensitive files.
FeatureTypes: Choose a room type for your goal: collaboration, public sharing, secure data, or a custom setup.
RoomsInfoPanel: Open the info panel to view room details, manage members, and track activity history.
RoomsQuickAccess: Recent rooms, favorites, the archive, and Trash are always at hand right under Rooms.
RoomsSearch: Quickly find the room you need by name.
RoomsView: Switch between the row and tile views — choose whichever is more convenient for you.
TourCreate: Pick a room type to get started: collaboration, public, custom, or a secure virtual data room.
TourFilter: Narrow the list by room type, tags, owner, or other parameters.
TourRooms: This is the Rooms section — shared spaces where you and your team collaborate on files.
TourTemplates: Save a room as a template and create new rooms with the same structure and settings in one click.
